catalogPath.meaning: Path of the catalog SQLite database.

entries.meaning: Known product entries ordered by id.

items.meaning: Known product entry; fields include schema, id, deviceId, host, port, manufacturer, productName, otherInfo, class, source, firstSeenEpoch and lastSeenEpoch.

firstMissingSignal.meaning: The enum lists fixed literal outcomes. The CLI also prints <raw filesystem or SQLite error text> and caduceus-pjlink-catalog-schema-desync; the HTTP gated read maps errors to the listed tokens.
